visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with glasses and a black shirt stands in front of a lush green banana plantation backdrop. He speaks energetically, gesturing with his hands and holding a blue and black pen. (2) A scientific image overlay appears showing two circular microscopic views of crystal formations labeled 'Ice XXI' and 'ruby'. The man remains in the foreground, pointing at the details. (3) The scene returns to the full view of the man speaking against the plantation background, his facial expressions shifting to match his enthusiastic narration. (4) A complex 3D molecular diagram of 'Ice XXI' with red spheres representing oxygen atoms and interconnected bonds appears behind him. He continues to gesture towards the visual aid. (5) A technical graph showing the phase transitions of water under compression and decompression cycles is displayed. The graph tracks pressure over time for various ice types. (6) The man concludes the video in the original plantation setting, maintaining eye contact with the camera and using expressive hand movements to emphasize his final points.

(6) [Subtitle]: 聯手德國電子同步加速器 (DESY) 等團隊. (7) [Subtitle]: 居然在室溫下發現了一種全新的冰形態. (8) [Subtitle]: Ice XXI. (9) [Subtitle]: 冰21. (10) [Subtitle]: 室溫下... 結冰. (11) [Subtitle]: 既然不靠冷就只能靠壓. (12) [Subtitle]: 沒錯 研究團隊拿兩個鑽石去壓水. (13) [Subtitle]: 壓到快 2 GPa. (14) [Subtitle]: 大約是地球表面氣壓的兩萬倍. (15) [Subtitle]: 結果剛在《自然材料》期刊上發表. (16) [Subtitle]: 但真正厲害的不是施加兩萬倍的壓力. (17) [Subtitle]: 這亞洲父母都辦得到. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate the audience about the discovery of 'Ice XXI,' a new form of ice created under extreme pressure. It explains the complex physics involved, such as the dynamic diamond anvil cell and X-ray lasers, while making the topic relatable through humor and references to space exploration.
